title: LectraAI Research — Timestamp Annotation Record
description: One file per lecture per annotator, per Phase 4 §7 / Phase 3 §8. Machine-readable, not hand-typed into results tables.

lecture_id.description: Matches dataset/manifest.csv lecture_id (never the raw YouTube ID directly, to keep annotators blind to source where practical).

annotation_pass.description: Phase 3/4 protocol: annotators must complete an independent_reference pass BEFORE seeing LectraAI's own output, to avoid anchoring bias. 'adjudication' records the reconciled final version after a disagreement (§ Human Annotation Protocol).

topic_label.description: Annotator's own short label for the topic (independent of LectraAI's topic titles).

end_sec.description: Must be >= start_sec. Represents the tolerance window during which the topic is first substantively introduced (Phase 3 §8), not every mention.

description.description: 1-2 sentence description of the concept, in the annotator's own words.

evidence.description: A short transcript quote or paraphrase justifying why this window was chosen.

is_primary_occurrence.description: false marks a secondary/later occurrence of a topic already annotated once (used only for the 'lenient' scoring variant, Phase 3 §8).

notes.description: Free-text: ambiguity, uncertainty, anything unusual about this topic's timing.
